CREATE TABLE preparation_batches (FOREIGN KEY(operation_id) REFERENCES inventory_operations (id), FOREIGN KEY(recipe_id) REFERENCES preparation_recipes (id), PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE (operation_id), created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, operation_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, recipe_id VARCHAR(32), snapshot TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE preparation_recipes (CHECK (status IN ('active','archived')), PRIMARY KEY (id), contents TEXT NOT NULL, created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, recipe_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(40))

CREATE TABLE prepared_materials (CHECK ((physical_id IS NOT NULL) + (spawn_id IS NOT NULL) <= 1), CHECK (material_type IN ('agar_plate','lc_jar','lc_syringe','spawn_jar','spawn_bag')), CHECK (stage IN ('preparing','ready','inoculated','completed','failed')), FOREIGN KEY(batch_id) REFERENCES preparation_batches (id), FOREIGN KEY(physical_id) REFERENCES physical_cultures (id), FOREIGN KEY(spawn_id) REFERENCES spawn (id), PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE (physical_id), UNIQUE (spawn_id), batch_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, material_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, physical_id VARCHAR(32), spawn_id VARCHAR(32), stage VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, use_by VARCHAR(10))

CREATE TABLE spawn (CHECK (material_type IN ('spawn_jar','spawn_bag')), CHECK (quantity IS NULL OR quantity >= 0), CHECK (quantity IS NULL OR unit IS NOT NULL), CHECK (stage IN ('ready','colonizing','used')), CHECK (status IN ('active','archived')), FOREIGN KEY(line_id) REFERENCES culture_lines (id), FOREIGN KEY(strain_id) REFERENCES strains (id), PRIMARY KEY (id), acquisition_date VARCHAR(10), created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, line_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, material_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(200), notes TEXT, quantity NUMERIC(14, 3), stage VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, storage_location VARCHAR(200), strain_id VARCHAR(32), supplier VARCHAR(200), supplier_batch VARCHAR(200), supplier_reference VARCHAR(200), unit VARCHAR(20))

CREATE TABLE spore_collections (FOREIGN KEY(fruiting_id) REFERENCES fruiting_containers (id), FOREIGN KEY(spore_id) REFERENCES spore_sources (id), PRIMARY KEY (spore_id), collection_date VARCHAR(10), fruiting_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, spore_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE spore_sources (CHECK (material_type IN ('spore_print','spore_syringe','spore_swab','other_spore')), CHECK (quantity IS NULL OR quantity >= 0), CHECK (quantity IS NULL OR unit IS NOT NULL), CHECK (status IN ('active','archived')), FOREIGN KEY(strain_id) REFERENCES strains (id), PRIMARY KEY (id), acquisition_date VARCHAR(10), created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, material_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(200), notes TEXT, quantity NUMERIC(14, 3), status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, storage_location VARCHAR(200), strain_id VARCHAR(32), supplier VARCHAR(200), supplier_reference VARCHAR(200), unit VARCHAR(20))

CREATE TABLE "stock_items" (CHECK ((category = 'source' AND (physical_id IS NOT NULL) + (spore_id IS NOT NULL) = 1) OR (category != 'source' AND physical_id IS NULL AND spore_id IS NULL)), CHECK (available IS NULL OR available >= 0), CHECK (category != 'reusable' OR (available IS NOT NULL AND unit = 'count')), CHECK (category IN ('ingredient','consumable','reusable','source','equipment','other')), CHECK (status IN ('active','archived')), FOREIGN KEY(physical_id) REFERENCES physical_cultures (id), FOREIGN KEY(spore_id) REFERENCES spore_sources (id), PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE (physical_id), UNIQUE (spore_id), available NUMERIC(14, 3), available_exact VARCHAR(64), category VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, container_type VARCHAR(30), created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, notes TEXT, physical_id VARCHAR(32), revision INTEGER NOT NULL, spore_id VARCHAR(32), status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, storage_location VARCHAR(200), unit VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE stock_transactions (FOREIGN KEY(item_id) REFERENCES stock_items (id), FOREIGN KEY(operation_id) REFERENCES inventory_operations (id), PRIMARY KEY (id), after_exact VARCHAR(64), after_quantity NUMERIC(14, 3), amount NUMERIC(14, 3), amount_exact VARCHAR(64), before_exact VARCHAR(64), before_quantity NUMERIC(14, 3), created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, entry_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, id INTEGER NOT NULL, item_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, operation_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, unit VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE strains (CHECK (status IN ('active','archived')), PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE (normalized_name), created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, description TEXT, id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, normalized_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, notes TEXT, scientific_name VARCHAR(200), status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE tent_occupancies (CHECK (left_at IS NULL OR left_at > entered_at), CHECK (revision > 0), FOREIGN KEY(fruiting_id) REFERENCES fruiting_containers (id), FOREIGN KEY(tent_id) REFERENCES fruiting_tents (id), PRIMARY KEY (id), entered_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, fruiting_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, id INTEGER NOT NULL, left_at VARCHAR(40), revision INTEGER NOT NULL, tent_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)

CREATE TRIGGER env_occupancy_overlap_insert BEFORE INSERT ON tent_occupancies WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tent_occupancies o WHERE o.fruiting_id=NEW.fruiting_id AND o.id != COALESCE(NEW.id,-1) AND (o.left_at IS NULL OR NEW.entered_at < o.left_at) AND (NEW.left_at IS NULL OR o.entered_at < NEW.left_at)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Overlapping tent occupancy'); END

CREATE TRIGGER env_occupancy_overlap_update BEFORE UPDATE ON tent_occupancies WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tent_occupancies o WHERE o.fruiting_id=NEW.fruiting_id AND o.id != COALESCE(NEW.id,-1) AND (o.left_at IS NULL OR NEW.entered_at < o.left_at) AND (NEW.left_at IS NULL OR o.entered_at < NEW.left_at)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Overlapping tent occupancy'); END

CREATE TRIGGER experiment_source_rules_historical_group_insert BEFORE INSERT ON experiment_source_rules WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM experiment_plan_revisions p, json_each(p.snapshot,'$.groups') g WHERE p.experiment_id=NEW.experiment_id AND p.revision=NEW.plan_revision AND json_extract(g.value,'$.id')=NEW.group_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Group is not in historical plan'); END

CREATE TRIGGER lineage_no_cycle_insert BEFORE INSERT ON line_parents BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Circular ancestry is not allowed') WHERE NEW.line_id IN ( WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(id) AS ( SELECT NEW.parent_id UNION SELECT p.parent_id FROM line_parents p JOIN ancestors a ON p.line_id = a.id ) SELECT id FROM ancestors ); END

CREATE TRIGGER lineage_no_cycle_update BEFORE UPDATE ON line_parents BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Circular ancestry is not allowed') WHERE NEW.line_id IN ( WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(id) AS ( SELECT NEW.parent_id UNION SELECT p.parent_id FROM line_parents p JOIN ancestors a ON p.line_id = a.id ) SELECT id FROM ancestors ); END

CREATE TRIGGER membership_unit_owner_insert BEFORE INSERT ON experiment_memberships WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM experiment_units u WHERE u.id=NEW.unit_id AND u.kind='container' AND u.fruiting_id!=NEW.fruiting_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Container unit must reference its own FR'); END

CREATE TRIGGER membership_unit_owner_update BEFORE UPDATE ON experiment_memberships WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM experiment_units u WHERE u.id=NEW.unit_id AND u.kind='container' AND u.fruiting_id!=NEW.fruiting_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Container unit must reference its own FR'); END

CREATE TRIGGER operational_spawn_on_registration BEFORE INSERT ON fruiting_runs WHEN NEW.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND ((SELECT count(*) FROM fruiting_sources WHERE fruiting_id=NEW.fruiting_id) != 1 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fruiting_sources WHERE fruiting_id=NEW.fruiting_id AND spawn_id=NEW.source_spawn_id)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'An operational grow must retain exactly its selected spawn source'); END

CREATE TRIGGER single_operational_spawn BEFORE INSERT ON fruiting_sources WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fruiting_runs r WHERE r.fruiting_id=NEW.fruiting_id AND r.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND r.source_spawn_id != NEW.spawn_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'An operational fruiting container has one spawn source'); END

CREATE TRIGGER single_operational_spawn_delete BEFORE DELETE ON fruiting_sources WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fruiting_runs r WHERE r.fruiting_id=OLD.fruiting_id AND r.operation_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Operational spawn provenance is permanent'); END

CREATE TRIGGER single_operational_spawn_update BEFORE UPDATE ON fruiting_sources WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fruiting_runs r WHERE r.fruiting_id=OLD.fruiting_id AND r.operation_id IS NOT NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Operational spawn provenance is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER unit_owner_update BEFORE UPDATE ON experiment_units WHEN NEW.kind='container' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM experiment_memberships m WHERE m.unit_id=NEW.id AND m.fruiting_id!=NEW.fruiting_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Container unit must reference its own FR'); END

CREATE TRIGGER valid_journal_photo BEFORE INSERT ON journal_photos WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM photo_attachments p JOIN fruiting_runs r ON r.fruiting_id=NEW.fruiting_id WHERE p.id=NEW.photo_id AND p.fruiting_id=NEW.fruiting_id AND ((NEW.event_type='completed' AND r.completed_date IS NOT NULL AND NEW.flush_number IS NULL) OR (NEW.event_type='fruiting' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fruiting_flushes f WHERE f.fruiting_id=NEW.fruiting_id AND f.number=NEW.flush_number AND f.fruiting_date IS NOT NULL)))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Journal photo must belong to its recorded event'); END

CREATE TRIGGER valid_pinning_photo BEFORE INSERT ON pinning_photos WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fruiting_flushes f JOIN photo_attachments p ON p.id=NEW.photo_id WHERE f.fruiting_id=NEW.fruiting_id AND f.number=NEW.flush_number AND f.pinning_date IS NOT NULL AND p.fruiting_id=NEW.fruiting_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Pinning photo must belong to its recorded flush event'); END
